meta.project: Odoo Workforce REST API & Database Engine

product_overview: Odoo Workforce is a multi-tenant HR management backend built on Node.js, Express, and MySQL with JWT-based authentication and strict tenant isolation. It supports employee administration, attendance tracking, leave workflows, payroll salary breakdowns, expenses, goals, announcements, and audit logging through a REST API.
core_goals: Provide a secure multi-tenant HR backend with company-level data isolation
Enable authentication and role-based access control using JWT and bcrypt
Support employee lifecycle management including onboarding, profile access, and salary breakdowns
Track attendance with check-in/check-out workflows and work-hour calculation
Manage leave requests, balances, approvals, and rejection reasons
Store and expose company departments, expenses, OKRs, announcements, and audit trails
Deliver reliable health and profile endpoints for operational monitoring and app integration

features.name: Healthcheck
features.description: Provides a public service status endpoint for uptime checks and deployment validation.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with service status
GET /api/health on a running instance -> Receive 200 with uptime/status details
GET /api/health during service outage -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Authentication and Session Context
features.description: Allows users to register a tenant, log in with login ID or email, and retrieve their authenticated profile context.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid company and admin details -> Receive 201 and new tenant/root super admin record -> POST /api/auth/login with valid identifier and password -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/me with bearer token -> Receive 200 with user profile and company metadata
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
POST /api/auth/register with mismatched password and confirmPassword -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/auth/me without bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication error

features.name: Employee Management
features.description: Supports listing employees, creating new employees, and retrieving detailed employee dossiers within the authenticated tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/employees with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with company employee list -> POST /api/employees with firstName, email, role, and joiningDate -> Receive 201 and newly created employee record -> GET /api/employees/:id with the new employee ID -> Receive 200 with deep employee profile dossier
POST /api/employees with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/employees/:id with an ID outside the tenant scope -> Receive 404 not found or access denied
GET /api/employees without bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication error

features.name: Salary and Payroll Breakdown
features.description: Returns statutory salary structure for an employee and supports payroll review for self, HR, and super admin roles.
user_flows: GET /api/employees/:id/salary with valid JWT and authorized role -> Receive 200 with statutory CTC breakdown
GET /api/employees/:id/salary for self profile -> Receive 200 with personal salary breakdown
GET /api/employees/:id/salary with unauthorized role -> Receive 403 forbidden error
GET /api/employees/:id/salary for unknown employee ID -> Receive 404 not found error

features.name: Attendance Tracking
features.description: Records employee check-in and check-out events and exposes work-hour computation through attendance history APIs.
user_flows: POST /api/attendance/check-in with valid JWT -> Receive 200 and open attendance punch for today -> POST /api/attendance/check-out with valid JWT -> Receive 200 and computed total work hours
POST /api/attendance/check-in when an open punch already exists for today -> Receive 400 conflict error
POST /api/attendance/check-out without a prior check-in -> Receive 400 invalid attendance state error
GET /api/attendance/today with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with current day's punch status
GET /api/attendance/history with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with attendance ledger for self or tenant context

features.name: Time Off and Leave Management
features.description: Lets employees view balances and request leave while managers or HR can review all requests and approve or reject them.
user_flows: GET /api/timeoff/me with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with leave requests and quota balances
GET /api/timeoff/balances with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with PTO and sick leave balances
POST /api/timeoff/request with valid dates, leave type, and reason -> Receive 201 and pending leave request
PATCH /api/timeoff/:id/status with approval and sufficient balance -> Receive 200 and approved leave status with updated balances
PATCH /api/timeoff/:id/status with rejection reason -> Receive 200 and rejected leave status
POST /api/timeoff/request with missing reason or invalid date range -> Receive 400 validation error
PATCH /api/timeoff/:id/status for unauthorized user -> Receive 403 forbidden error

features.name: Departments
features.description: Provides department listing and administrative CRUD for organizational structure.
user_flows: GET /api/departments with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with department list and metadata
POST /api/departments with valid department name and description -> Receive 201 and created department record
PUT /api/departments/:id with updated manager or description -> Receive 200 with updated department data
DELETE /api/departments/:id with super admin access -> Receive 200 or 204 confirming deletion
POST /api/departments with missing name -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /api/departments/:id without super admin role -> Receive 403 forbidden error

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Lets employees submit expense claims and allows authorized reviewers to manage claim status.
user_flows: GET /api/expenses with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with expense claims visible to the caller's role
POST /api/expenses with title, category, amount, and receipt URL -> Receive 201 and pending expense claim
PATCH /api/expenses/:id/status with approval -> Receive 200 and updated claim status
PATCH /api/expenses/:id/status with rejection reason -> Receive 200 and rejected claim status
POST /api/expenses with missing amount or title -> Receive 400 validation error
PATCH /api/expenses/:id/status without reviewer permissions -> Receive 403 forbidden error

features.name: Goals and OKRs
features.description: Allows users to view, create, and update performance goals and progress within their tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/goals with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with OKR goal list filtered by user or quarter
POST /api/goals with title, description, quarter, and employee target -> Receive 201 and new goal record
PATCH /api/goals/:id/progress with progress percentage -> Receive 200 and updated goal status
PATCH /api/goals/:id/progress with invalid progress below 0 or above 100 -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/goals without bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication error

features.name: Announcements
features.description: Delivers company bulletin announcements and supports posting new announcements for authorized staff.
user_flows: GET /api/announcements with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with company announcements sorted by pinned status
POST /api/announcements with title and content as authorized role -> Receive 201 and new bulletin record
POST /api/announcements with missing content -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/announcements without HR or super admin role -> Receive 403 forbidden error

features.name: Audit Logs
features.description: Exposes chronological security and compliance trails for super admin review.
user_flows: GET /api/audit-logs with super admin JWT -> Receive 200 with chronological audit trail entries
GET /api/audit-logs with non-super-admin JWT -> Receive 403 forbidden error
GET /api/audit-logs without bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication error

endpoints.description: Creates new company tenant and root super admin
Authenticates user with identifier (admin@odooindia.com or OI220001) and password (Password@123)
Returns authenticated user profile context and company metadata
Lists all employees for the company tenant
Creates new employee with required fields
Records clock in / check-in timestamp for the authenticated user
Records clock out / check-out timestamp and computes work hours
Returns leave requests and quota balances for current user
